ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a transition-state structure with curved arrows; on the left is a six-membered carbon ring, fused with a six-membered ring containing N on the right. The upper part of the right ring is connected to O-H and R², the lower right is connected to R¹, and N-H, one C-H, and a positive charge symbol are also marked inside the ring. The curved arrows only indicate electron movement and are not counted as bonds. Reasoning: Count according to connections between heavy atoms, and exclude all bonds involving hydrogen. The left fused six-membered carbon ring has 6 C-C connections along the ring perimeter. The right N-containing ring still needs counting of 5 ring connections not repeatedly included in the left ring, because the fused C-C edge has already been included in the 6 connections of the left ring. There are 3 visible non-hydrogen substituent bonds outside the ring: C-O, C-R², C-R¹. Exclude O-H, N-H, the marked C-H, and all curved arrows. Therefore the total is 6 + 5 + 3 = 14.

raw_record.question_text:
In the transition-state structure shown in the image, calculate the total number of bonds in the structure, including single, double, and triple bonds but excluding those involving hydrogen.

Note: Disregard arrows. Consider all components present in the transition-state structure shown in the image.

method.method_draft: First describe the visual structure, then count heavy-atom bonds by tracing the scaffold. Count the 6 C-C connections around the left fused six-membered ring. Move to the right N-containing ring and count only the 5 additional ring connections not already included, since the fused C-C edge was counted with the left ring. Add the 3 non-hydrogen substituent bonds visible outside the rings: C-O, C-R², and C-R¹. Skip O-H, N-H, the labeled C-H, and all curved arrows. Total: 6 + 5 + 3 = 14.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个带弯箭头的过渡态结构；左侧是一个六元碳环，与右侧含 N 的六元环稠合。右侧环上方连有 O-H 和 R²，右下方连有 R¹，环内还标有 N-H、一个 C-H 以及正电荷符号。弯箭头只表示电子移动，不作为键计数。
推理：按重原子之间的连接计数，并排除所有涉及氢的键。左侧稠合六元碳环沿环周有 6 个 C-C 连接。右侧含 N 环还需要数 5 个未在左环中重复计入的环连接，因为稠合的 C-C 边已经包含在左环的 6 个连接中。环外可见的非氢取代基键有 3 个：C-O、C-R²、C-R¹。排除 O-H、N-H、标出的 C-H 以及所有弯箭头。因此总数为 6 + 5 + 3 = 14。

method.method_draft: First describe the image and label the heavy-atom graph. Let A and B be the two fused ring atoms. The left ring has four additional atoms L1-L4 with adjacencies A-L1-L2-L3-L4-B-A. The right ring has A-T-U-V-N-B-A, where T is the carbon bearing O and R², and V is the carbon bearing R¹. Add substituent adjacencies T-O, T-R², and V-R¹. Now count non-H incidences: A=3, B=3, L1-L4 contribute 2 each, T=4, U=2, V=3, N=2, O=1, R¹=1, R²=1. The incidence sum is 28, so the number of heavy-atom bonds is 28/2 = 14. Exclude O-H, N-H, and C-H from the degree counts.
